en: A hand‑colored historic postcard showing a large three‑storey school building fronting a broad square. The central section has an entrance with steps, arched windows, and a clock above, flanked by symmetrical wings with many rectangular windows. Small trees line the front of the building. Surrounding the square are other multi‑storey town buildings, and a tall factory chimney is visible in the background. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Sophienplatz with the Bürgerschule in Colditz.
